markdownRemark.html:
I build scalable cloud infrastructure, automate developer workflows, and ship secure software fast. Whether it's Kubernetes clusters at sea or DevSecOps platforms used by enterprises, I take hard problems and turn them into working systems.

Core toolkit:

  • ☁️ Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure
  • 🐳 Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, OpenShift
  • 🏗️ Infrastructure as Code: Pulumi, Terraform, OpenTofu
  • 👁️ Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics
  • 🌐 Networking: Cloudflare, Tailscale, Nginx, Traefik, MQTT, Cilium
  • 🧠 AI: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Ollama, MCP
  • 🤖 ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, MLflow, MLOps
  • ⚙️ Backend: Go, Python, Node.js, TypeScript
  • 🔄 DevOps: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Balena, CI/CD
  • 🔒 Security: Trivy, Syft, Checkov, ZAP, Burp, SAST/DAST
  • 🗄️ Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL
  • 🖥️ Frontend: React, Gatsby, Next.js, Vue, Angular
  • 🔧 Hardware: Custom PCs, Home Lab, Game Hosting, Raspberry Pi, Device Repair

Currently exploring: AI tooling with local LLMs (Ollama) and agentic coding assistants. Building side projects like an AI meal planner, a lab tools web app, and a Discord bot economy system, all deployed to a home lab on hardware I built and configured myself. Only move workloads to the cloud when I hit vertical scaling issues or have credits to burn on AWS and GCP. Tinkering with Raspberry Pi, home automation, and device repairs on old phones and Apple watches.

Curious about this site? It's built with Gatsby and deploys via GitHub Actions. Check out the source code.

frontmatter.title: The Will of the People
frontmatter.description: A Discord bot that became the engine of a server economy, casino, and voice. Runs on a Raspberry Pi 5 after migrating from AWS EC2 when credits ran out.

frontmatter.title: Lil Chef
frontmatter.description: A local-first web app that generates weekly meal plans using AI. The theme is a rat chef doing the planning, you are just the prep cook.

frontmatter.title: Home Lab
frontmatter.description: Multi-device home lab built from scratch. Raspberry Pis and custom-built computers running a Tailscale mesh, Cloudflare tunnels, game servers, and network services.

frontmatter.title: Echo Protocol
frontmatter.description: A web tool for generating Beckman Echo liquid handler protocols. Runs locally as a standalone Python app or Docker container so users can connect their own data. Designed to run on a Raspberry Pi.

frontmatter.title: Games Arcade
frontmatter.description: 7 classic arcade games in a single HTML page, served by a lightweight Python HTTP server. Containerized for ARM64/AMD64 and ready for Raspberry Pi deployment.

frontmatter.title: Configs
frontmatter.description: Cross-machine development environment configuration toolkit. Shell configs, modular aliases, a Docker dev container image, and an install script that detects OS, architecture, and hardware.
